desc: Design prime-based construction: M = p where p = kN+1 is prime, A = g^k with g primitive root.
Factor N by trial division using precomputed primes up to 31623.
Implement Miller-Rabin primality test for 64-bit integers.
For each N, find k starting from 1, compute p = k*N+1, check if p > 1e18 break.
If p is prime, factor p-1 = k*N by combining factors of k and N.
Find primitive root g mod p: test g=2,3,5,... and check g^{(p-1)/q} != 1 for all prime factors q of p-1.
Set A = pow(g, k, p). Then A has order N mod p.
